versions.changelog:
elderly-ui-audit 0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Performs automated UI elderly-friendliness audit based on Chinese MIIT standards for websites and mobile apps.
- Scans project code for compliance across font, color, interaction, captcha, ads, navigation, and compatibility.
- Generates detailed HTML report (elderly-audit-report.html) with problem summary and actionable suggestions.
- Supports both comprehensive and single-item checks.
- Provides methods for both detection and auto-fix where applicable.
